messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: GPU pool us-west-2-ml-1 saturated. queue_growth detected on inference-queue (avg wait > 12s, 95th > 45s). autoscaler attempted scale-up x3 but hit tenant scale_limit. Suspected MIG fragmentation causing stranded GPUs. Paging oncall.
Priya: Oncall ack. I'm looking at console now. Confirming: high pending requests, errors = 0 but long latency. Marking P1 and starting customer impact sweep. @Katie please pull list of heavy tenants hitting us-west-2.
Katie: On it. Querying logs now — looks like 4 top customers are 10x baseline for last 30m. Sending list in a sec.
Katie: (paste) top-attach: acme-inc, vectra-ai, beta-labs, internal-loadtest.  acme-inc and vectra-ai show sustained concurrency bursts. Opening customer DMs to warn about degradation.
Marcus: I'm seeing scheduler logs: a lot of small MIG slices (e.g., 1g.5gb) are scattered, binpacker can't compact due to pinned pods with anti-affinity/taints. Repack job failed earlier due to eviction-thresholds set high.
Marcus: Snippet from scheduler log:
```
ERROR placement: no valid node for pod 0x7f3c - candidate nodes: [node-114 node-237 node-402], reason: MIG mismatch (requested 1g.5, best fit 2g.10), fragmentation_score=0.78
```
Jing: We hit autoscale hard limit for this pool — config shows max_replicas=120 and we're at 118. Autoscaler tried to request more but cluster quota prevented additional MIG slices. Also seeing high deferred-repack queue.
Priya: Decision call quick: immediate mitigations we can try now: 1) temporary bump pool max_replicas (if quotas allow) 2) enable emergency repack with forced evictions on low-priority pods 3) route heavy tenants to fallback model variant (lower GPU/memory) 4) throttle internal loadtests.
Leo: I can flip routing fallback for vectra-ai and acme-inc to a smaller model (redwood-mini-quant) to reduce per-request GPU time. That should drop token throughput by ~40% and free slots.
Marcus: Repack attempt 1: triggering `repack --pool us-west-2-ml-1 --mode aggressive --evict-priority low` now. Expect churn; this will cause short-term increased queue while nodes drain and reallocate.
Jing: Trying to bump pool max_replicas to 160. Request to infra quota service sent — may take 2-3m. If denied, we need plan B.
pd-bot: PagerDuty: Incident acknowledged by Priya. Assigned to Priya, notify schedule followups.
Priya: I'm starting customer comms for acme-inc and vectra-ai: short message "we're seeing elevated latency, working on mitigations; may route to fallback model". Katie please post and paste copy here.
Katie: Posting now. Message template: "Hi — we detected higher than normal inference latency in us-west-2. We are actively mitigating (fallback routing + repack). You may see brief increased latency during rebalancing. Will update in 10m. — Redwood SRE"
Marcus: Repack progress: 12% nodes repacked, we freed 3 MIG slices so far. But we uncover fragmentation islands: several nodes with 0.5G leftover that cannot be used for new pods due to MIG sizing mismatch.
Priya: Next actions if repack stalls: force-evict some non-critical reserved pools (internal-loadtest), then trigger emergency-burstpool to accept overflow requests but with reduced QPS to avoid overload.
Leo: I've enabled fallback routing for the two tenants. Initial metrics show per-request GPU time down 38% and queue depth dropping slightly.
Jing: Quota bump approved. Scaling to 160 in flight. Autoscaler should start provisioning additional MIG slices; expecting new capacity in ~6-8m.
Marcus: Note: after scale completes we still need to compact leftovers. Plan: 1) let scale finish, 2) run a second aggressive repack with `--consolidate-only` to minimize churn.
Priya: Customer impact summary so far (to post in status): - Impact: elevated latency for a subset of customers in us-west-2; no 5xx errors detected. - Affected tenants: acme-inc, vectra-ai, beta-labs (partial), internal-loadtest. - Mitigations: fallback routing (done for top2), emergency repack (in progress), pool max_replicas bumped (in progress). ETA next update: 10m.
Katie: Posted status update to status.redwood.com with those notes + link to this thread.
Marcus: Repack is at 58% now. We recovered 21 MIG slices net. Some nodes still show stranded capacity due to old pinned pods; opening PR to allow temporary override of pin flags for low-priority reservations.
Priya: Handing immediate oncall to Marcus for the next 25 minutes to run the consolidation and monitor customer impact — I'll remain in-thread for stakeholder comms. @pd-bot update oncall.
pd-bot: PagerDuty: Ownership transferred to Marcus.
Marcus: Running consolidate-only repack now; command:
```
repack --pool us-west-2-ml-1 --mode consolidate-only --max-concurrent-evicts 8
```
Marcus: Consolidate run completed. We reclaimed 37 stranded slices overall. Queue depth returning to baseline. Autoscaler back to normal behavior.
Priya: Thanks team — good mitigation. Post-incident actions: 1) review MIG sizing defaults (many tenants requesting odd slices) 2) add automated burstpool for short spikes 3) lower eviction thresholds during high fragmentation windows 4) run a tabletop for repack behavior. I'll open the incident postmortem and assign owners.
Katie: Noting customer follow-up: email sent to acme-inc and vectra-ai with details + credits offered for interruption window.
incident-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED: time to resolution ~42m. Severity: P1 -> Resolved. Summary link: <internal/incident/5160007890>
Priya: Closing thread. If anyone has logs or followups, post here and I'll add to the postmortem.
